module: Shared utility functions of the jbeam loader: adding nodes and beams to the vehicle under construction (maxIDs counters, options copy), adding rotators, and computing the nodeRotate / nodeOffset / nodeMove transformations applied to node and flexbody positions (with cache), plus two string.buffer encoding helpers. Used by the wheel handlers, the loader and the editor; a mod that generates vehicles through code can use it to add nodes/beams.
usage:
local jbeamUtils = require('jbeam/utils')
local n = jbeamUtils.addNodeWithOptions(vehicle, vec3(0, 0, 1), 0, {nodeWeight = 5})
local b = jbeamUtils.addBeamWithOptions(vehicle, n1, n2, 0, {beamSpring = 1e6})
notes: Node and beam ids are 0-based cids; vehicle.maxIDs[name] counts the elements already created (increaseMax returns the value BEFORE incrementing, so the next free cid).
addNode/addBeamWithOptions copy (deepcopy) the options table received: the options of a wheel or of the vehicle (vehicle.options) become the fields of each node / beam created.

addBeamWithOptions: id1/id2 are used to look up vehicle.nodes[id] (key = cid, and in the loader also the node name); if id1/id2 are nil they are read from options.id1/options.id2. The id1, id2 fields of the created beam are the cids of the nodes found. If a node is invalid, the function logs a warning and returns nil (without creating a beam): the callers (wheel handlers) do not check this return value.
With id3 (3rd node), the beam becomes an L-beam (BEAM_LBEAM = 4) regardless of beamType and b.id3 is set.
Hardcoded C constants: NORMALTYPE = 0, BEAM_LBEAM = 4 (do not change).

jbeam transformations: the keys 'nodeRotateN', 'nodeOffsetN' and 'nodeMoveN' (N = 0 to 99, 1 or 2 digits) of a jbeamData block are {x, y, z} tables (nodeRotate: angles in degrees around x/y/z, with optional pivot px, py, pz). They apply in increasing order of N, and for each N: rotation, then offset, then move. nodeOffset is ignored if jbeamData.ignoreNodeOffset is true; its x is multiplied by the sign of posX (left/right symmetry).
The transformation functions share a module-level cache (only one transformation at a time) and temporary vectors/quats: not reentrant.
The rotation Euler angles are those of MatrixF (intrinsic ZXY), in radians with inverted sign for jbeam angles (rad(-angle)).

ignoreSections.desc: jbeam sections ignored by some processing: {maxIDs = true, options = true}.

increaseMax.desc: Reserves the next id: returns vehicle.maxIDs[name] (0 if nil) then increments the counter.

addNodeWithOptions.desc: Adds a node to the vehicle (table.insert in vehicle.nodes) with the fields of `options` copied, plus cid, pos and ntype.

ntype.desc: node type (0 = NORMALTYPE, C engine values)

options.desc: options to copy into the node (nodeWeight, collision, group...)

addNode.desc: addNodeWithOptions with the vehicle's global options (vehicle.options).

addBeamWithOptions.desc: Adds a beam between two existing nodes with the options copied, plus cid, id1, id2 (node cids) and beamType. With id3, creates an L-beam (BEAM_LBEAM). Returns nil with a warning if a node cannot be found.

id1.desc: first node (key in vehicle.nodes; nil = options.id1)

beamType.desc: beam type (0 normal, 1 anisotropic, 3 pressurized, 7 support... C engine values)

returns.desc: beam created (with cid), nil on failure

addBeam.desc: addBeamWithOptions of type NORMALTYPE (0) with the vehicle's options.

addRotator.desc: Prepares a rotator (wheel without a tire): frictionCoef is 1 by default; collects the nodes of the _group_nodes and _rotatorGroup_nodes groups into wheel.nodes (references to vehicle.nodes).

getPosAfterNodeRotateOffsetMove.desc: Position (x, y, z) after applying the nodeRotate / nodeOffset / nodeMove transformations contained in jbeamData. Without a transformation, returns x, y, z unchanged.

jbeamData.desc: jbeam block containing the nodeRotateN / nodeOffsetN / nodeMoveN keys

getFlexbodyPosRotAfterNodeRotateOffsetMo.desc: Position and rotation (degrees, rx/ry/rz) of a flexbody after applying the nodeRotate/nodeOffset/nodeMove transformations. Without a transformation (opCount == 0) returns nothing (nil). Without rotation, returns only the offset x, y, z.

returns.desc: rx (degrees), only if there is a rotation

getPosRotBeforeNodeRotateOffsetMove.desc: Inverse operation: recovers the original position and rotation (before nodeRotate/nodeOffset/nodeMove) from transformed values. Tests the signs of x (1, 0, then -1) because nodeOffset depends on the sign of posX.

stringBufferEncode.desc: Encodes data with string.buffer (buf:encode) into a new buffer and returns it (LuaJIT binary format).

stringBufferDecode.desc: Decodes the value at the head of a string.buffer WITHOUT consuming it (buf:peekdecode()).
